body: Founder asked to stop scaling the live bot pool via Claude Code manually and get self-service control instead. Added emily redgarden bots [N] (default 20) + emily redgarden status. Edits live ~/.config/systemd/user/redgarden-bot-pool.service ExecStart= + Description= in place, daemon-reload + restart. Verified live: 20 -> 19 (1 human slot opened at :7778) -> 20 (self-sustaining), confirmed via live bot process count each step. Commit 6d6bff9.
